name: Altan
description: A young Mardu rider who opposes Paala's participation in the Lightning Proving, attacks her, and then accepts her help.

description_citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story
description_citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The captain begins the proving and Altan accuses Paala of shaming the rite.
timeline.quote: You shame the proving by your participation.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Altan ambushes Paala with a knife in the foothills but his falcon falls in a rockslide and pins his leg.
timeline.quote: they both went tumbling down the rise.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Paala frees Altan from the rocks, saying it is the Mardu thing to do, and agrees to take him to the summit.
timeline.quote: It's the Mardu thing to do.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Paala wakes tied to her saddle as Emina, Altan and the archer lead her back toward the band.
timeline.quote: Her hands were tied to the pommel of her saddle

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2025.

relations.note: opposes her place and attacks her
relations.quote: You are arrogant to have come this far where you're not wanted,
